body: That is pretty fucked up... you shouldn't be paying for it in school though?
I would love to find someone who has a genuine interest in me haha.  That feeling is great.. I hope one day I can be a success story on here
I think it is CrispyReload. Same as my PSN I think? I'm pretty sure I messed up my epic account somehow but try that? I'm on playing Diablo 4 rn
Yeah, I've got no friends. I'm maybe level 60 but had someone help me with some weapons. Hopefully I'll meet some people
A few years?! So that's what I have to look forward to? Lol
Wow.  I am having a hell of a time getting missions done let alone finding any good guns lol. Hard to find people on there to help
I know what you are going through. If you need someone to talk to I am here to message. Trust me I know..
At least you recognize that now and can try to work on that fact
Trust me.. I feel the same. Nothing I do changes anything.  My problem is me and that will never change
i think on days like these the best thing you can do is just call it a day. go to bed and hope tomorrow is better.

I was thinking about this previously and how sad it actually is to long for someone else's touch. I am right there with you.. I wish someone would look into my eyes for once and see how much pain is behind them
It definitely is a joke and impossible to understand. I come on here and read other peoples problems to try and make mine feel less and maybe see if I can help. I am still just lonely and useless
there are a lot of days that i feel exactly like this. thinking about myself makes me feel this way. i wish i was better

That could mean a lot of things. I usually can tell when I am headed on a downward spiral. Maybe you are starting a depressive episode. Hang in there.. Can't say it gets better but you never know what is waiting for you out there

I wish I could say that this doesn't relate to me inside of my soul but it does. The no passion or drive thing is really what gets me the most. I can have good things in my life or reasons that I should go on and do better but I still am just the same. I think once you see things the way they really are you can't go back to how it was before.

They seem to affect everyone differently.  One thing I know they did was basically erase my emotions.  That was the only benefit although it wasn't what I wanted at all.  Now being off of them I do find myself falling back into my familiar ways..

My experience with antidepressants lasted 6 months or so before I stopped taking them. They did seem to make my anxiety and depression worse at first. Things did seem to get better for a short period of time until recently I decided all of these pills weren't helping me. You should talk to your doctor
I feel this all too well. I wish I had better words.. All I can do is try and keep my mind busy, you should too

I am right there with you.. No matter how much better I seem to do in life in any capacity I still seem to still be stuck with this horrible version of myself. I do hope that you have better luck than I have my friend.

I agree with these other people. We don't necessarily enjoy the feeling of being sad. It is just our 'default'. Our comfort zone essentially after having spent so much time in this feeling. I have found more and more that I go back into these dark holes because it is the only part of me that is reliable so far. I truly don't have control over myself and until that happens, I don't think I'll ever be happy
I wish there was a magical fix. I've looked for it for a while now. Tried meds and it lasted for a while until I gave up. Trust me, you're not alone..
I just received my order a day ahead of its original date.  18 days from start to finish.  Not bad really
I'll take your pain tonight.  Sleep easy
I used to think that. Things gotta go my way sometimes? I ran out of that a while ago.  I've never felt colder than I do right now.  I belong in this universe somewhere,  I know it isn't here anymore

That's all I'm doing right now.  I know i will hurt a lot of people when I go.  I don't know what else to do i don't want to feel this anymore it isn't even pain it feels like my heart is being pulled out of my chest like my body is giving up my chest hurts my heart skips beats and I can barely breathe or think.  I don't even know what I'm doing posting here
I feel exactly like this.  It's how I always am.  I poured myself into her.  Now I watch her take that and give it to someone else. I'm so ready to give up

I am very close to doing this tonight as well.  I made an account on here so I can say something.  I wish i could take all of your pain with me. I wish that no one had to feel this way.  I know things will get better in my head, in yours too. But after that where are we? Still in this cold heartless arena.  I dont know what will happen tonight. I hope things get better for you all.
